AMOUNT_DROP.description: Payment far BELOW the sender's own usual amount (probing / layered micro-payments / structured small pieces)

BEHAVIOUR_CHANGE.description: Amount far outside the sender's own historical pattern

CASH_VELOCITY.description: High count of cash deposits/withdrawals on one account

CIRCULAR_FLOW.description: Funds return to the originator through a loop of accounts (round-tripping)

CURRENCY_CONVERSION.description: Currency conversion on the payment (payment vs received currency differ)

CUSTOMER_JURISDICTION.description: High-risk customer transacting through a very-high-risk jurisdiction (combination is far worse than either alone)

DORMANT_REACTIVATION.description: Long-dormant account suddenly moves a material amount

FAN_IN.description: Many distinct senders into one account in a short window

FAN_OUT.description: One account paying many distinct receivers in a short window

HIGH_RISK_CUSTOMER.description: Sender or receiver belongs to a customer rated high risk (or a PEP)

HIGH_RISK_JURISDICTION.description: Transaction touches a high-risk (or very-high-risk) jurisdiction

INCOME_MISMATCH.description: Amount or 30-day outflow out of proportion to the customer's declared income

LARGE_TXN.description: Single transaction at or above the large-value threshold (GBP)

PASS_THROUGH.description: Funds received and forwarded almost in full within hours (pass-through / rapid movement)

REPEATED_PAIR.description: Same sender/receiver pair transacting repeatedly (smurfing / drip transfers)

SANCTIONED_JURISDICTION.description: Payment involving a sanctioned jurisdiction (OFAC-style screen). Counterparty side alerts alone; the sender's own country is weighted by origin_factor

STRUCTURING_BAND.description: Amount just below the reporting threshold; stronger when repeated by the same sender

STRUCTURING_HUB.description: Slow fan-in of sub-threshold amounts from many senders (structuring hub)

TRADE_MISPRICING.description: Large payment from a trade-based customer (import/export): trade-based money laundering / mispricing

WATCHLIST_HIT.description: Sender or receiver account is on an internal watchlist / sanctions list
